caption: Returns a new array, same length, every element transformed. Original untouched.
Returns a new, possibly shorter array — only elements where the test is true.
An accumulator carries forward — the second argument is its starting value.

code:
const transactions = [
  { to: "0xAb12...", value: 100n },
  { to: "0xCd34...", value: 0n },
  { to: "0xEf56...", value: 250n },
];

const total = transactions
  .filter((tx) => tx.value > 0n)
  .map((tx) => tx.value)
  .reduce((sum, v) => sum + v, 0n); // 350n
caption: Filter down, map to the field you need, reduce to one total — a constant blockchain-code pattern.
